steps.en: Officer has revived a reduction or permanent suspension
steps.id: Officer sudah me-revive reduction atau permanent suspension

steps.en: A work item listing the revived notices is created
steps.id: Work item berisi notice yang di-revive dibuat
steps.why_en: No code creates a work item after a revival.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang membuat work item setelah revival.

steps.en: The work item appears on the supervisor's dashboard
steps.id: Work item muncul di dashboard supervisor
steps.why_en: The dashboard is empty and the work item menu is switched off.
steps.why_id: Dashboard kosong dan menu work item dimatikan.

steps.en: The supervisor reviews and endorses the revival
steps.why_en: Endorsement exists only for another feature, not for revivals.
steps.why_id: Endorsement hanya ada untuk fitur lain, bukan untuk revival.

steps.en: Only a supervisor can endorse, and the result is recorded
steps.id: Hanya supervisor yang bisa meng-endorse, dan hasilnya dicatat
steps.why_en: There is no supervisor role or endorsement record for revivals.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada peran supervisor atau catatan endorsement untuk revival.
